---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D horror escape game based on the user’s Russian concept: escape an ancient monster’s cave quietly while keeping a handheld torch lit.

## Requirements
- Implement the game directly without asking clarifying questions.
- User asked for screenshots for checks to be saved as small JPEGs (viewport at most 1280px wide).

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js game in `index.html`, with Russian interface text, desktop keyboard/mouse controls, and mobile touch controls.
- Added stealth/noise, torch fuel and oil pickups, a chasing monster, and an exit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game and added a local dev server, currently started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Added README-independent game controls, HUD, title/game-over/victory screens, cave environment, torch, monster, and audio effects.
- Reduced rendering load by lowering pixel ratio, geometry count, and limiting render rate.

### Active
- Validate the game in-browser and take/inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/current.jpg --type=jpeg` repeatedly times out after 5 seconds, despite page navigation succeeding. Earlier render load may have caused WebGL context loss; performance optimizations were made afterward but capture still times out.
- Browser console previously reported a 404 for `/favicon.ico`; it is not consequential to gameplay.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser validation; inspect browser errors and determine why screenshots time out.
2. Save and inspect a JPEG screenshot at or below 1280px wide.
3. Check basic play controls, monster chase, torch fuel, and win/lose paths; fix any issues.
4. Report assumptions and implementation briefly when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all game code, styles, gameplay, controls, and UI.
- `screenshots/`: intended location for the requested JPEG check; currently screenshot creation has failed.

## Important Context
- User’s concept in Russian: “3 д игра в котором игрока очень страшный древний монстр затаскивает в пещеру… нужно выбраться из пещеры тихо ходя чтобы монстр его не услышал, при этом держа в руке факел горячий и смотреть чтобы он не потух”.
- `index.html` is the only project source file added/changed for gameplay. Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshot attempts timed out with `TimeoutError: page.screenshot: Timeout 5000ms exceeded`.
